summary.method: Live HTTP GET from audit workstation; no JavaScript; Accept-Encoding gzip; status before redirects. Sample: top 22 GSC pages plus primary comparisons, archives, nine language roots, trust pages, and URL variants. User-agent Mozilla/5.0. Not Google URL Inspection or a complete HTTP crawl.
summary.sitemapUrlHttpCoverage: Only sampled canonical pages checked by HTTP. Remaining URLs have sitemap presence/alternate checks only; HTTP and indexing unknown.
summary.indexingCaveat: Performance impressions confirm appearance in search during export, not current Google-selected canonical/index status. Absent sitemap URLs are not proven unindexed or zero-impression.
summary.gscUrlNormalization: Trailing slash removed for inventory matching only. /nl and /nl/ source rows aggregated: 1 click,127 impressions; position impression-weighted from rounded source values. Raw exported rows remain in url-buckets.csv.
